English: Gathering Patch
A rough patch of trampled earth where the tribe gathers to speak and settle disputes. The simplest form of communal assembly.
Council Circle
A ring of logs and stones forming a basic council area, granting more order and organization to tribal gatherings.
Speaking Stone
A prominent stone set in the center of the moot, from which speakers address the clan. Symbolizes authority and tradition.
Delegates Tent
A cluster of well-appointed tents for tribal delegates, ensuring protection and privacy during crucial assemblies.
Elders Pavilion
A sturdy timber and hide pavilion reserved for the eldest and most respected, marking a new age of tribal governance.
Law Stone
A carved monolith bearing the tribes laws, now central to all assemblies. Its presence strengthens unity and the legitimacy of rulings.
Moot Stand
A raised wooden dais for the presiding chieftain and elders, offering clear authority and oversight at all council meetings.
Judgement Hall
A semi-permanent timber hall for legal proceedings and the settling of disputes, solidifying the tribes rule of law.
High Moot Pavilion
A grand, richly adorned pavilion hosting the most vital and influential clan gatherings, projecting strength and unity to all.
Realm Assembly Hall
A permanent stone-and-timber hall, seat of the realms highest assembly, where every major law and alliance is forged.
